extracted.name: Irresistible Marinated Seafood (捞汁海鲜)
extracted.description: This Irresistible Marinated Seafood is fresh, tangy, and packed with flavor! A mix of shrimp, scallops, mussels, langostino lobster, and seafood medley is quickly cooked, chilled, and marinated in a vibrant sauce made with soy sauce, honey, vinegar, lemon juice, and homemade chili oil. Perfect as a refreshing appetizer or a light main dish, especially for summer gatherings! Enjoy!
ingredient_lines: 2 oz (about 60 ml) homemade chili oil (Adjust all ingredients to taste)
instruction_lines: Step 1: Cook the seafood and chill Boil all seafood for about 1-2 minutes until just cooked. Immediately transfer to ice water to cool, then drain well. Place the cooled seafood and the sliced lemon quarters in a large container.
Step 2: Add the marinade Combine the cooked seafood with the scallions, ginger, garlic, honey, soy sauce, vinegar, and lemon juice. Stir well to combine.
Step 3: Add chili oil Pour in the homemade chili oil and stir again, ensuring the seafood is evenly coated with the marinade.
Step 4: Chill and marinate Refrigerate the seafood for 15-30 minutes (or up to 4-6 hours for deeper flavor). Enjoy!
